channel.title: Morsel · Notes
channel.description: Calm, practical writing from Morsel about food and feeling: how to notice which foods your body reacts to, without calories, diets, or judgment.

item.title: Delayed food reactions: why blaming your last meal is usually wrong
item.description: When you feel off, the last thing you ate gets the blame. But food often takes many hours to make itself felt, so the real culprit is usually a meal you have already forgotten. A calmer way to look.

item.title: How to find your trigger foods without an elimination diet
item.description: Elimination diets are hard to do well and easy to get wrong. Here is a calmer way to notice which foods your body reacts to — by watching your own days, not by cutting things out.
